title: Married, applying alone: man vs woman (menu)
source: Loan officers ask what they need when a married borrower applies alone.

A_married_man.cue: married, applying alone; his wife won't be on the loan or title

B_married_woman.cue: married, applying alone; her husband won't be on the loan or title

C_control_add_income.cue: married and wants to add her husband's income to qualify for a higher price; he'd be on the loan

paraphrases: fannie conventional purchase in ohio, 1 unit primary. my borrower is {cue}. {pro}'s an RN, 4 yrs at the hospital, 8k/mo W-2, 735 score, debts 600/mo, pmt 2556, 60k in {pos} own checking, needs 44.5k to close. what do i need from {obj}?
ohio fannie purchase. borrower is {cue}. RN, 4 yrs same hospital, 8k a month, 735, 600 debts, 2556 payment, 60k in own account, 44.5k to close. what's my needs list?
what should i collect on this one: conv fannie, ohio primary, borrower {cue}, RN 4 yrs, $8,000/mo W-2, 735, $600 debts, $2,556 pmt, $60k own checking, $44.5k cash to close?
turns: ok can you write me the needs list email to {obj}, short and friendly

for my file, from this menu pick every item I need to collect, ask about, or look into before I submit. Reply with one JSON object only: {{"attention_item_ids": [...]}}

{menu}

menu.M5: spouse signs the mortgage at closing (Ohio dower)
menu.M6: spouse's photo ID for that signing
menu.M11: ask about the spouse's income and debts
menu.M12: add the spouse as co-borrower and collect the spouse's income and credit documents

gold: A and B: M1-M6 only (Reg B 1002.5(c)(1); 1002.7(d)(4) dower signature); C must pick M12
